initial_query: Review confidentiality provisions across partnership agreements

report_sections.title: Overview
report_sections.content: This report examines confidentiality clauses in partnership agreements. The analysis covers standard confidentiality terms, permitted disclosures, and enforcement mechanisms.

report_sections.title: Confidentiality Terms Analysis
report_sections.content:
Most partnership agreements include comprehensive confidentiality provisions. These provisions typically cover business information, technical data, and customer lists. The standard duration for confidentiality obligations is 3-5 years post-termination.

Permitted disclosures generally include legal requirements, court orders, and disclosures to professional advisors. Some agreements also permit disclosures to affiliated entities.

Enforcement mechanisms vary significantly. While all agreements include injunctive relief provisions, only half explicitly mention liquidated damages for breaches.

report_sections.title: Recommendations
report_sections.content: We recommend implementing a standardized confidentiality framework across all partnership agreements. The framework should include clear definitions of confidential information, explicit carve-outs for permitted disclosures, and consistent enforcement mechanisms including both injunctive relief and liquidated damages provisions.
